steps.say: **Practice min/student/week** is the top bar: this class's own minutes of practice per student per week.
The bars below it are the school average and the global average for the same course. Compare the lengths, and the numbers at the end give the exact figures.

Dividing by students and by weeks is what lets a class of nine and a class of thirty be compared honestly. A class with too little practice recorded shows a plain line saying so rather than a bar built from almost nothing.
steps.terminal: That's this class's effort, put on the same footing as everyone else's. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
